messages.en:
{07 00 00}Thanks, {04 1f 00}! That
was actually a lot of fun.

I didn't think you'd put up
such a challenge. And I
had no idea you'd beat me!
{07 14 00}I guess maybe it's time to
hang up my fishing rod
for a bit, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1a 00}After all, you are truly
the finest fisher in all of
{04 03 00}, {04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Thanks for letting me
watch you in action!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Aitäh, {04 1f 00}! See oli
tegelikult väga lõbus.

Ma ei arvanud, et sa oled
nii tugev vastane. Ja ma ei
aimanud, et sa mind võidad!
{07 14 00}Vist on aeg mu õng
mõneks ajaks varna
riputada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1a 00}Lõppude lõpuks oled sina
tõesti parim kalamees kogu
{04 03 00}, {04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Aitäh, et lasid mul sind
tegutsemas vaadata!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}You've beaten me for now,
{04 1f 00}, but just you
wait, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I guess I've got no regrets
for.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}losing our fishing
match.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Honestly, I did have a good
time, {04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}and I
learned a lot from you.
{07 1a 00}Hands down, you're the best
fisher in {04 03 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Sa võitsid mind praeguseks,
{04 1f 00}, aga oota
sa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma vist ei kahetse
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}meie kalamatši
kaotust.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}Ausalt, mul oli tõesti tore,
{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}ja ma
õppisin sinult palju.
{07 1a 00}Selge see, et sa oled parim
kalamees {04 03 00}!
